steps.body: Paper clips work as units too, as long as every clip is the same size. The unit does not have to be a cube.
steps.narration: Paper clips work as units too, as long as every clip is the same size. The unit does not have to be a cube.

widget.prompt: Measure the path with two-unit clips this time — three of them, end to end.
widget.successFeedback: Three two-unit clips cover the path exactly, so the path is three clips long.
widget.alignFeedback: Line up zero with the object's starting end before measuring.
widget.gapOverlapFeedback: The blocks must touch end to end — no spaces and no covering the same part twice.
widget.unitFeedback: Every block must be the same size, or the count means nothing.

predict.prompt: The same ribbon is measured in cubes and in longer clips. Will the counts match?
predict.reveal: Longer units cover more each, so the same ribbon needs fewer of them.

widget.prompt: A stick measures 12 small cubes. Measured with units twice as long, will the count be more or fewer? Choose the key measurement idea.

options.label: More big units than small units
options.feedback: A longer unit covers more ground per placement, so the count must go down, not up.

options.label: Exactly the same number
options.feedback: The count only stays the same if the unit stays the same size.

options.label: Fewer big units than small units
options.feedback: Correct — bigger units cover more length each, so it takes fewer of them for the same object.

options.label: The object changed length
options.feedback: The object never changed; only the size of the measuring unit did.

widget.prompt: Mia's crayon is 8 clips long. Ben's pencil is 8 cubes long, and a clip is bigger than a cube. Are the crayon and the pencil the same length?

options.label: Yes — both counts are 8
options.feedback: Same count, but a clip covers more length than a cube, so equal counts do not mean equal length.

options.label: No — the crayon is longer
options.feedback: Correct — each clip covers more length than a cube, so 8 clips covers more length than 8 cubes.

options.feedback: Clips are the bigger unit here, so the bigger length belongs to the clip count, not the cube count.

options.label: Cannot tell from the counts
options.feedback: You can tell without remeasuring: the count made of the bigger unit (clips) covers more length, even though the numbers match.
